examples.scenario: Pixel center lies exactly on parcel exterior ring.
examples.reason: contains is false for boundary-only points while covers is boundary-inclusive.

examples.scenario: Pixel center lies strictly inside parcel polygon.
examples.reason: contains/covers and inverse predicates must reconcile.

examples.scenario: Pixel center lies outside parcel but inside its bbox.
examples.reason: STRtree bbox hit is candidate-only.

examples.scenario: Pixel center lies on hole boundary.
examples.reason: Boundary semantics must not be confused with hole interior.

examples.scenario: Pixel center lies inside parcel hole.
examples.reason: Hole interior is exterior to polygon area.

examples.scenario: intersects is true because center touches boundary.
examples.reason: intersects is broader than parcel interior membership.

examples.scenario: touches is true for a boundary point.
examples.reason: touches requires no interior-interior intersection.

examples.scenario: contains and covers disagree.
examples.reason: Boundary-specific disagreement is semantically meaningful.

examples.scenario: covers(A,p) differs from covered_by(p,A).
examples.reason: Converse predicates must agree.

examples.scenario: contains(A,p) differs from within(p,A).
examples.reason: Inverse relationship must reconcile.

examples.scenario: Prepared geometry result differs from unprepared geometry.
examples.reason: Preparation is an optimization, not a semantic change.

examples.scenario: Boundary is modified after prepare but not re-prepared.
examples.reason: Prepared index belongs to previous geometry object/state.

examples.scenario: Invalid self-intersecting boundary is used directly.
examples.reason: Invalid geometries can yield incorrect predicate results.

examples.scenario: Validity reason reports self-intersection.
examples.reason: Repair or reviewed source correction is required.

examples.scenario: MakeValid linework produces GeometryCollection.
examples.reason: Repair can change structural type and lower-dimensional components.

examples.scenario: MakeValid structure produces a different polygon from linework.
examples.reason: Repair method affects resulting domain.

examples.scenario: MakeValid silently becomes canonical boundary.
examples.reason: Derived repair cannot replace immutable source without explicit provenance.

examples.scenario: set_precision collapses a narrow parcel sliver.
examples.reason: Precision grid may alter membership area.

examples.scenario: set_precision creates empty polygon.
examples.reason: Empty derived geometry cannot define target membership.

examples.scenario: intersection grid_size snaps boundary before membership.
examples.reason: Terminal geometry must not mutate implicitly.

examples.scenario: normalize changes ring ordering only.
examples.reason: Normalization is useful for deterministic structural comparison, not domain mutation.

examples.scenario: topological equals true but equals_exact false.
examples.reason: They answer different QA questions.

examples.scenario: equals_exact differs only by vertex ordering.
examples.reason: Canonical ordering can remove serialization-only differences.

examples.scenario: STRtree query returns a bbox hit without predicate.
examples.reason: Bounding boxes overselect irregular polygons.

examples.scenario: STRtree ignores raster-cell elevation Z.
examples.reason: Membership is horizontal 2D; elevation remains separate.

examples.scenario: A point is within 1mm of boundary but outside.
examples.reason: dwithin/buffer tolerance must not redefine legal parcel domain.

examples.scenario: A buffer is added to make borderline cells pass.
examples.reason: Terminal membership uses exact canonical polygon.

examples.scenario: Cell footprint intersects parcel but center is outside.
examples.reason: Raster-center membership and area-overlap are different policies.

examples.scenario: Center is inside but part of cell footprint is outside.
examples.reason: Do not silently switch to full-cell containment.

examples.scenario: Multipolygon parcel has center in second part.
examples.reason: Membership source component should remain auditable.

examples.scenario: Center lies between disjoint multipolygon parts inside overall bbox.
examples.reason: Exact geometry predicate rejects the gap.

examples.scenario: Boundary geometry is None.
examples.reason: Missing geometry cannot yield membership.

examples.scenario: Boundary is empty geometry.
examples.reason: No parcel domain exists to test.

examples.scenario: GeometryCollection boundary is used without part policy.
examples.reason: Expected polygonal domain must be explicit.

examples.scenario: Lower-dimensional line survives MakeValid.
examples.reason: Lower-dimensional repair artifacts cannot define area membership unless explicitly reviewed.

examples.scenario: Prepared covers short-circuit handles an interior point.
examples.reason: Optimization must preserve exact predicate result.

examples.scenario: Boundary-touch case triggers full topology in GEOS.
examples.reason: Touch cases cannot always be resolved by short-circuit tests.

examples.scenario: DE-9IM matrix changes across engines.
examples.reason: Boolean agreement alone may hide relationship differences.

examples.scenario: Shapely covers and PostGIS ST_Covers disagree on sample cell.
examples.reason: Same GEOS-backed topology should be reconciled before terminal acceptance.

examples.scenario: GDAL IsValid differs from Shapely is_valid.
examples.reason: Runtime/library versions and geometry bytes must be investigated.

examples.scenario: Boundary digest changes but topology is equal.
examples.reason: Immutable source bytes changed even if shape remains topologically equal.

examples.scenario: Membership bitmap digest changes while counts match.
examples.reason: Cell identities must match, not just cardinality.

examples.scenario: Membership bitmap matches but serialization order differs.
examples.reason: Stable ordering avoids false digest differences.

examples.scenario: Second-pass scan reverses tile order.
examples.reason: Membership result must be iteration-order independent.

examples.scenario: Seam cell appears in two tiles but same parcel membership.
examples.reason: Tile overlap must not double count parcel cells.

examples.scenario: Seam cell disappears from both tiles.
examples.reason: Complete raster-domain coverage is required.

examples.scenario: Boundary count unexpectedly becomes zero after precision change.
examples.reason: Precision mutation may erase boundary contacts.

examples.scenario: Interior count changes after MakeValid.
examples.reason: Repair altered terminal membership domain.

examples.scenario: contains_xy used for millions of centers.
examples.reason: Faster point predicate is acceptable only with exact semantic parity.

examples.scenario: intersects_xy(boundary,x,y) is true.
examples.reason: Boundary extraction provides an independent touch classifier.

examples.reason: Single-geometry validity does not detect cross-feature overlaps.

examples.scenario: Boundary and raster CRS differ.
examples.reason: Predicate must operate in one verified horizontal coordinate domain.

examples.reason: Topology preparation is not numeric terrain measurement.

examples.reason: Preparation confidence is not target measurement accuracy.
